findings.claim: Passing named owner-runtime evidence for all 23 required scenarios is absent.
findings.observed: The task checkpoint states owner-runtime GREEN remains blocked by a semantically divergent owner contract, and the supplied behavioral run reports 23 tests with 12 passing and 11 failing rather than 23 passing named OR-01 through OR-23 results.
findings.rationale: Goal goal-001 requires passing named automated evidence for every owner-runtime scenario; a blocked/failing owner-backed run and separate supporting local totals do not establish that acceptance gate.
findings.required: Provide a reviewable mapping of OR-01 through OR-23 to passing automated results at the required owner-listener and isolated-SQLite boundaries using an approved converged immutable owner checkout.

findings.claim: The mandatory owner-runtime TDD proof is incomplete because it has no matching-command GREEN result.
findings.observed: The supplied proof records a genuine owner-backed RED with exit code 1 and 11 failing scenarios, while the checkpoint explicitly says the proof helper refused to record false GREEN and owner GREEN remains blocked.
findings.rationale: The manifest declares TDD required, so a RED-only artifact cannot demonstrate the required failing-then-passing behavioral cycle for the owner-runtime goal.
findings.required: After converging against an approved immutable owner checkout, capture a passing GREEN execution of the identical recorded behavioral command and retain both phases with owner revision provenance.
